verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs imply hardware can be ordered from the Customer Area dashboard, since the Management API orders terminals 'instead of the Customer Area'. They also offer a standalone terminal as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments' and say 'Get started fast'. Nothing documents self-serve signup, approval/underwriting speed, or a same-week go-live timeline. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup and approval flow, onboarding/approval timeline, terminal delivery timeline, explicit dashboard ordering docs, independent corroboration of same-week activation.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
want the quickest way to accept in-person payments, we also offer a standalone terminal solution.
Get started fast with a full range of PCI PTS 6 certified terminals.
